<a id="summary"></a>

## Summary

macOS re-pairs the Anticater knob at times and steals it from the ESP32 bridge. A launchd job runs scripts/mac_knob_guard.sh every 10 s: if blueutil shows the knob (by address ee-aa-b8-d6-82-5e or an ANTICATER name) paired to the Mac, it disconnects and unpairs only that device and logs one JSON line; a failing blueutil query is logged as an error instead of silently doing nothing. just mac-guard-on/off/status.

<a id="goals"></a>

## Goals

- The knob stays with the ESP32 without Vaughan disconnecting it on the Mac.
- Never touch any other Bluetooth device.
- Easy to turn off (rollback to the Mac daemon).
